title: Were any bybit_2 perps open at 2026-11-05T16:00Z? (decides whether 'no 16:00Z settlement' is right)
note: Open question from BYBIT2-FUNDING-SETTLEMENT-READ. Txn log has rows to 16:20Z but no 16:00Z SETTLEMENT for bybit_2. Check trade_journal trades for account bybit_2 with opened_at <= 16:00Z < closed_at (diag journal?table=trades) and positions at that time.
